description: Stop watching a mark. This DELETES the watch (a side effect — it is removed and will no longer be checked). Returns JSON { removed, ok: true }. If the watch has an email, you must prove you own it — pass the email and the 6-digit code from request_watch_code, or a session token. A watch with no email needs no verification.

code.description: 6-digit code from request_watch_code, for the email above

id.description: Watch id (e.g. novabrew) or the mark name

sessionToken.description: 60-minute watch session token from a previous verification

name: unwatch_mark
